messages:
irene (Docs): quick heads-up: webhook verification example in API ref shows header `x-hmac-signature` and HMAC digest in lowercase hex, but prod uses `X-HMAC-Signature` and uppercase hex. our Python verification snippet failed for a customer.

raj (API): thanks. link?

irene (Docs): https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/webhooks/receive -> response headers + sample verification code.

samira (Security): thanks for catching. our verifier accepts either case but the docs mismatch caused confusion in examples and some libs treat header names case-sensitively. we should canonicalize docs to `X-HMAC-Signature` (capitalized) and show uppercase hex.

niko (SDK): SDK verification helper expected uppercase hex and `X-HMAC-Signature`. i pushed a quick patch but the docs example made people copy the lowercase sample. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/310

raj (API): i'll update the OpenAPI examples to use `X-HMAC-Signature` and uppercase hex string. also add a note: "Header name is case-insensitive per RFC but examples use canonical header name." PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1177

irene (Docs): i'll open docs PR to update the example snippet and add a troubleshooting FAQ line "signature hex case mismatch" with recommended SDK helper usage. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/623

samira (Security): can we also add a verification example in Go and Node showing tolerant parsing (accept either case and hex case-insensitively)? small snippet will save support time.

niko (SDK): will add tolerant parsing and a debug log when we normalize incoming signature. published canary with fix: 0.15.0-canary.3.

docbot: docs deploy queued by irene for 2026-04-06T09:00:00-07:00 :rocket:

irene (Docs): merged docs PR, verified snippets in storybook, added FAQ and support ping.

docbot: docs deploy successful (v2026-04-06-0900) :white_check_mark: live on staging.

raj (API): updated internal generator to emit canonical header name in examples to prevent regressions.

samira (Security): closing loop  thanks team — recommend follow-up: add an automated linter to check header names in examples.

irene (Docs): noted; will add to docs backlog. :memo:
